sources.title: Herduck src/api/schema.rs
sources.finding: The complete product API exposes work/project views and plan updates, sessions, workspaces, panes, worktrees, events and plugins. No native external issue sync, task hierarchy, billing, organization roles, deployment or PR operations occur in this method surface.

sources.title: Herduck src/cli/spec.rs
sources.finding: The herduck CLI routes work plan, overview and follow-up plus pane/agent/session/worktree operations to the shared local API.

sources.title: Herduck src/projects/catalog/topic_cover.rs
sources.finding: SQLite stores authored goal/next_steps/blocker under stable topic key. Transactional update supports expected_updated_at conflicts; model regrouping keeps cover-only topics. Only latest cover is stored, not a revision history.

sources.title: Herduck src/projects/cover.rs
sources.finding: Authored Work plan has goal, up to3 next steps, blocker note and timestamp. blocked_session_ref is reserved absent. There are no parent/child, acceptance-gate, task-state, owner or approval fields.

sources.title: Herduck src/projects/overview.rs
sources.finding: The shared view has needs-input/working/ready/paused/open/history counts and session evidence. Suggestions bind an ID to evidence and require explicit Continue; idle/history are not completion.

sources.title: Herduck src/app/project_followup.rs
sources.finding: Follow-up checks exact current suggestion, reuses matching original runtime or resumes its native conversation, waits for confirmed original agent idle, cancels replaced targets, and caps16 pending/128 retained records in server memory.

sources.title: Herduck src/projects/adapters.rs
sources.finding: Five native history adapters: Codex, Claude, Pi, OpenCode and Grok. Bounded file/depth/JSON scans import metadata and references, not an external issue tracker; parse failures are isolated.

sources.title: Herduck src/projects/transcript.rs
sources.locator: read_transcript; read_full_transcript; collector limits; backend dispatch
sources.finding: Local readable transcript paths support Claude/Codex/Pi/Grok; OpenCode indexing does not provide readable transcript preview. Preview caps500 messages and4000 characters per message; full-message cap8MiB.

sources.title: Herduck src/projects/domain.rs
sources.finding: Stable keys derive from backend and canonical session identity. Semantic grouping fingerprint includes title/cwd/backend; topic keys normalize labels. Allowed-root and ID validation constrain history references.

sources.title: Herduck src/api/server.rs
sources.finding: API is local socket with0600 permissions, request-size and timeout bounds. It is a single-OS-user boundary rather than team identities or scoped project roles.

sources.title: Herduck src/terminal/runtime.rs
sources.finding: Native terminal runtime delegates PTY process creation, input, visible/recent text and shutdown to PaneRuntime. Ordinary local shell/agent processes are not isolated containers or VMs.

sources.title: Herduck src/persist/restore.rs
sources.finding: Normal restore reconstructs layout and fresh shells in saved working directories with supported native-agent resume plans; live handoff has a separate inherited-runtime path. This is not arbitrary process checkpoint restoration.

sources.title: Herduck src/persist/io.rs
sources.finding: Local session.json/session-history.json snapshots use temporary-file rename; clearing deletes those files. No immutable audit log or hosted-history replication is implemented here.

sources.title: Herduck src/remote/unix.rs
sources.finding: Inherited SSH thin-client launcher is disabled in this revision. Its presence in source does not make remote provisioning an accessible Herduck feature.

sources.title: Herduck src/config/model.rs
sources.locator: UpdateConfig defaults; ProjectsSummaryConfig and provider settings
sources.finding: Automatic version/manifest checks default false. Summary generation is configured separately, defaults off, supports explicit provider chains and environment-key names.

sources.title: Herduck src/projects/semantic.rs
sources.finding: Opt-in summary provider sends selected prompt to configured HTTP endpoint with optional bearer key from environment, timeout and status handling; quota/model errors drive fallback. This is model traffic, not telemetry collection.

sources.title: Herduck src/logging.rs
sources.finding: Diagnostics write to local files, default info filter and5MiB limit with0 retained rotated files. No network event transport is implemented in this logging path.

sources.title: Herduck src/update.rs
sources.finding: Self-update disabled by constant; configured checks use curl to fetch release JSON without event payload. No analytics counting is established by functional update retrieval.

sources.title: Herduck src/worktree.rs
sources.finding: Product creates/lists/opens/removes Git worktrees and branch paths through Git commands. This is checkout separation, not privilege/network/secret containment.

sources.title: Herduck src/plugin_command.rs
sources.finding: Plugin commands execute local programs via std::process::Command; Windows batch commands use shell handling. No independent plugin sandbox or team approval boundary is implemented here.

sources.title: Herduck docs/topic-covers.md
sources.locator: Persistence and scope; CLI; Socket API
sources.finding: Manual explicitly limits Work to authored plans and states artifact lists, task stages, approval flows and multi-user permissions are out of scope. Guarded editor/CLI/API updates share the Catalog.

sources.title: Herduck docs/project-overview.md
sources.finding: Overview uses newest50 sessions and recent evidence from4; local evidence cache15seconds. Follow-up delivery records do not survive server restart or live handoff; saved Work plans and native history do.

sources.title: Herduck docs/installation.md
sources.finding: Alpha prebuilt distribution supports macOS Intel/AppleSilicon and Linux x64/arm64 glibc2.39+, not Windows or musl. Existing agent CLIs and accounts installed separately.

sources.title: Herduck README.md
sources.finding: Independent Herdr-derived open-source terminal app. Multiple CLIs in native terminal panes,19 screen detection manifests,5 history adapters, independent agent accounts. Generation off by default.

sources.title: Herduck docs/configuration.md
sources.finding: Local catalog/config/history; explicit optional model chains may send conversation content to remote providers even via local agent CLI. API key values use environment; automatic updates off.

sources.title: Herduck LICENSE
sources.finding: Repository is distributed under AGPLv3; README specifies AGPL-3.0-or-later.

sources.title: Herduck alpha.5 release
sources.finding: Ships Quick Keys and per-agent close that alpha.4 did not include; macOS/Linux native downloads, npm launcher, separate agent installs. Windows/musl unsupported, macOS ad-hoc signed not notarized.

sources.title: herduck src/app/api/layouts.rs
sources.finding: Resolves a workspace/tab target, builds its layout description and returns LayoutExport JSON or a specific not-found error; not a full hosted-account migration exporter.
